item.description:
Nib no longer uses CPU in the background after you dictate. This update also brings live meeting captions and more flexible dictation keys.

  • The animated dictation outline now pauses whenever the pill is hidden, instead of redrawing continuously while Nib is idle.
  • Meetings open a live transcript panel with MAI-Transcribe 2 captions through your OpenRouter key, editable speaker names, notes, and retry for missing captions.
  • The voice key and keyboard dictation shortcuts are interchangeable: start with either and tap either to finish.
  • Automatic dictation retries log a short diagnostic that contains no audio or text.

Nib now keeps dictated model names and version numbers exactly as spoken, and returns the dictation pill cleanly to its compact shape after automatic retries.

  • Cleanup no longer substitutes more familiar names or versions, including Luna/Llama and Gemini 3.8/3.5.
  • Personal-dictionary spellings are treated as authoritative.
  • The retry card no longer leaves an expanded border around the compact pill.

Nib’s floating interfaces now have a crisp animated gradient outline inspired by modern glass controls.

  • The outline moves slowly around dictation, edit, retry, and error surfaces.
  • The effect stays on the perimeter without bleeding into the glass and respects Reduce Motion.
  • The native-glass waveform no longer shows a rectangular backing layer.
